units.container_s_per_video_s: seconds of one container of the kind's pool per second of episode video, amortized over `concurrency` episodes in flight per container
units.startup_s: seconds from container start to ready (@modal.enter), paid once per container
units.uncertainty: relative half-width of the error bar (0.35 = +/-35%)

balanced_slot: The `balanced` segment and caption rows below are the measurement slot (planner.rates.MEASURED_SLOTS). To record a measurement, edit only those rows: set `container_s_per_video_s`, `uncertainty`, `status` (placeholder -> measured), `source` (the doc or run that measured it), `date`, `image` and `provenance`; no code change is needed. Their status must be placeholder or measured, and a measured row must name its source and date. Until then `flora plan` labels every option that uses them `estimate (placeholder)`.
note: `status`: measured | projected | placeholder | stale. `stale` entries were measured on another image or superseded by a measurement of the same configuration; they are kept for history only and lookups skip them. `requires` names worker features a rate depends on; `excludes` names features whose presence makes the rate invalid (the S1 row was measured with gpu_thread off). The deployed configuration's features are `planner.rates.DEPLOYED_FEATURES` (gpu_thread: `stages.reference.ExactProfile.gpu_thread`, on by default since P1a-5s); a rate that needs a feature outside it (e.g. `long_lived_container`) only appears in projection options, which are never recommended. At equal concurrency a measured entry beats a projected one whatever its `requires` (review 5 M-C). `image`: the image the entry was measured or projected on. `cameras` "*": measured on a 1-/3-view mix. Determinism mode (`pipeline.determinism: deterministic`, cuDNN SDPA off) has no rate of its own: docs/determinism.md measured <= 3% end to end before gpu_thread; it is not re-measured on the current profile and does not pay the cold cuDNN graph tax, so its rate will differ; do not reuse these rows for it without a measurement.

rates.provenance: S1 fast composite c=4 on H200, gpu_thread OFF: 6 golden episodes (81.0 video s, 1-/3-view mix) in 566 s = 0.143 video-h per GPU-h; generation ~3x slower on cu128 than cu130 (cold cuDNN graph builds) (docs/exact-worker.md, docs/perf-1.md). Valid only with gpu_thread disabled (ExactProfile disable=gpu_thread)

P1a-5s fully wired exact worker, c=4, gpu_thread on (the deployed default), H200: one 6-episode golden shard, 80.97 video s in 519 s batch wall = 6.41 container-s per video-s (0.156 video-h per container-h). Caveats: (1) cameras: a 1-/3-view mix (half of the 6 episodes are 3-view), so it is bucketed cameras "*", not 1; (2) memory: the run's container had 160 GiB ($6.20/h, $39.7/video-h) while the preset's default pool is 96 GiB ($5.68/h, $36.4/video-h); the planner and budget price the configured pool, and c=4 inside 96 GiB is not re-measured; (3) it includes the per-shard fill/drain idle (~110 s fill bubble while 4 episodes run NVIDIA's input probe and decode, plus the drain tail: ~21% of the wall; generation alone is 5.04 GPU-s per video-s), which recurs on every shard at the default 10-GPU-minute shards, and ~3.5 min of contention with an FP32 Captioner prefetch/hash that production does not do (pessimistic); (4) one short-lived container with a cold Captioner graph cache. Excludes @enter (78 s) and scheduling. Re-measure on a long-lived multi-shard run (docs/exact-worker.md, review 5)

Perf-1 projection with gpu_thread (GPU bound 6.3 -> <= 3.9 GPU-s per video-s; W3-A's CPU/straggler ceiling at c=4 = ~0.23 video-h per container-h). Superseded by the P1a-5s measurement of the same configuration (6.4, measured): a short-lived container keeps the Captioner cold and pays the shard fill/drain bubble. Kept for history (docs/perf-1.md, docs/exact-worker.md)

W3-A steady-state projection (1.9 GPU-s per video-s at ~90% lock occupancy +16% contention = ~0.40 video-h per container-h, 1-view basis). Needs a long-lived container with a warm Captioner graph cache (scaledown / min_containers), 8 episodes in flight and overlapping shards (no fill/drain bubble); the deployed configuration provides none of these (ExactProfile.concurrency is 4 and not set from flora.yaml), otherwise ~4-5 (docs/perf-1.md, docs/exact-concurrency.md, review 5 segcap P1)
W3-A run 1 sequential on the cu130 image: 4 WS-D episodes (1080p HomER, 153.6 video s) in 1,322 s on H200 = 0.116 video-h per container-h (docs/exact-concurrency.md). Not valid for cu128
W3-A run 1 concurrency 4 on the cu130 image: 626 s = 0.245 video-h per container-h (docs/exact-concurrency.md). Superseded by S1 on cu128 (7.0)

W3-A run 2 sequential on the cu130 image: 2x ALOHA 3-view (640x480, 44.0 video s) in 175 s; low resolution, 2 episodes (docs/exact-concurrency.md). 3-view lookups now fall back to the 1-view cu128 rows
